test_objective: Check that you can delete a VocabProperty property from an entity

test_cases.name: 013_07_01 Delete a VocabProperty property from an entity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can delete a VocabProperty property from an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json'
}
